field_descriptions.default_value: The default value of the input.  For properties that expect a literal, the default is a literal value, for properties that expect an object, it's an ID reference to one of the current values.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.max_value: The upper value of some characteristic or property.
field_descriptions.min_value: The lower value of some characteristic or property.
field_descriptions.multiple_values: Whether multiple values are allowed for the property.  Default is false.
field_descriptions.readonly_value: Whether or not a property is mutable.  Default is false. Specifying this for a property that also has a value makes it act similar to a "hidden" input in an HTML form.
field_descriptions.step_value: The stepValue attribute indicates the granularity that is expected (and required) of the value in a PropertyValueSpecification.
field_descriptions.value_max_length: Specifies the allowed range for number of characters in a literal value.
field_descriptions.value_min_length: Specifies the minimum allowed range for number of characters in a literal value.
field_descriptions.value_name: Indicates the name of the PropertyValueSpecification to be used in URL templates and form encoding in a manner analogous to HTML's input@name.
field_descriptions.value_pattern: Specifies a regular expression for testing literal values according to the HTML spec.
field_descriptions.value_required: Whether the property must be filled in to complete the action.  Default is false.
